tasks.label: Commit, Deploy & Backup (layout e dados corrigidos)
args:
set -euo pipefail

# Build already done; stage and commit with requested message
if ! git diff --quiet || ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
  echo "📝 Committing changes..."
  git add -A
  git commit -m "layout e dados corrigidos"
else
  echo "ℹ️  No changes to commit."
fi

# Deploy
echo "🚀 Deploying..."
chmod +x deploy-full-automated.sh
./deploy-full-automated.sh

echo "🗄️  Running database backup with label..."
chmod +x scripts/backup-database.sh
./scripts/backup-database.sh --db "airtrust-db" --label "layout e dados corrigidos"

echo "🎉 All done: commit, deploy, and backup complete."

tasks.label: Sync template company 6 from company 1
args: cd /Users/filipedaumas/Documents/Airtrust && npx wrangler d1 execute airtrust-db --remote --command "UPDATE empresas_config SET certificado_template_html = (SELECT certificado_template_html FROM empresas_config WHERE empresa_id = 1), updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE empresa_id = 6" && npx wrangler d1 execute airtrust-db --remote --command "INSERT INTO empresas_config (empresa_id, certificado_template_html, timezone, idioma, updated_at) SELECT 6, certificado_template_html, 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'pt-BR', datetime('now') FROM empresas_config WHERE empresa_id = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM empresas_config WHERE empresa_id = 6)" && npx wrangler d1 execute airtrust-db --remote --command "UPDATE certificados_templates SET ativo = 0, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE empresa_id = 6 AND deleted_at IS NULL" && npx wrangler d1 execute airtrust-db --remote --command "UPDATE certificados_templates SET template_json = (SELECT certificado_template_html FROM empresas_config WHERE empresa_id = 6), nome = 'Template Certificado Ativo', ativo = 1, padrao = 1, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM certificados_templates WHERE empresa_id = 6 AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1)" && npx wrangler d1 execute airtrust-db --remote --command "INSERT INTO certificados_templates (empresa_id, nome, template_json, ativo, padrao, created_at, updated_at) SELECT 6, 'Template Certificado Ativo', certificado_template_html, 1, 1, datetime('now'), datetime('now') FROM empresas_config WHERE empresa_id = 6 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM certificados_templates WHERE empresa_id = 6 AND deleted_at IS NULL)"
